notes.title: Thank you for playing the Demo!
notes.content: [h2]🌊 Thank You, Castaways! 🌊[/h2][p][/p][p][i]We’re so grateful for everyone who has taken the time to play the Capy Castaway demo. 💖[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340812/5eb1087c3b4d08c155adc0884af6125f3fad555d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]From your feedback and bug reports, to the wonderful art you’ve shared, and of course all the silly (and sometimes questionable!) soups you’ve cooked up, you’ve filled our little island with joy.[/p][p]Your creativity and support help us make Capy and Corvi’s adventure even cozier, and we can’t wait to share more with you.[/p][p][/p][h3]🍊 Haven’t wishlisted yet? [/h3][p]The best way to support us right now is to add Capy Castaway to your Steam wishlist. Every wishlist helps us reach more players and keeps Capy’s journey afloat.[/p][p]Wishlist Capy Castaway on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2890240/Capy_Castaway/"]Steam[/url]![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]✨ Want to stay updated?[/h3][p]Make sure you’re subscribed to our newsletter and follow Capy Castaway on Bluesky, you’ll get sneak peeks, cozy updates, and a little extra Capy + Corvi joy delivered straight to your inbox.[/p][p]Subscribe to our [url="https://capycastaway.com/"]Newsletter [/url][/p][p]Follow us on [url="https://bsky.app/profile/capycastaway.com"]Bluesky [/url]or join our [url="https://discord.gg/zQgfEsG "]Discord [/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for being part of our cozy community. We couldn’t do this without you. 💕[/p][p][/p][p][i]— The Kitten Cup Studio Team[/i] [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo patch update v0.1.2
notes.content: [h2]Hey Castaways, [/h2][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who has played the Demo already, it’s been such a joy reading your comments and hearing about your favourite parts of the demo, like stacking yuzu on your head![/p][p][/p][p]We are at the halfway point for the public Demo, and we're a week away from Gamescom. We've made a couple of quality-of-life updates thanks to your feedback, so please read below for all the details.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340812/57f0a069d6bf56957507dcd5d49d186d838376a7.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Here are the details of the patch update. [/p][p][/p][h3]🐛Bugfixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where Capy could infinitely duplicate a stick.[/p][/*][*][p]Mac no longer hangs when restarting the game (doesn’t restart yet, but at least it won’t crash!)[/p][/*][*][p]Removed a textbox that appears when the game first fades in.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed items sometimes flickering when getting picked up.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error that happened when trying to wear an item immediately after grabbing it.[/p][/*][*][p]Non-US keyboards now display prompts in the correct language, show sprites for input prompts.[/p][/*][*][p]Hats now scale correctly after respawning (no more weird stacking sizes).[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced shakiness on the UI and pause screens.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]📋Performance[/h3][list][*][p]Major performance improvements! Game should run smoother and at a higher framerate.[/p][/*][*][p]Added quality and resolution sliders to the pause menu, adjust them to your needs.[/p][/*][*][p]Trees and bushes fade between LODs better for smoother performance.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you like to [b]report a bug[/b] in-game, when you're in the [b]pause menu[/b], you can select [b]Bug Reporter. [/b]Additionally, we are still collecting player feedback, which you can share  [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdxhy7VZTU8-NZcP2X06qfDeDPOf4OzTAgA5rze_YQKRuLoSQ/viewform" style="button" buttoncolor="#20ceb0"][b]here[/b][/url]  or on our [url="https://discord.gg/zQgfEsG"]Discord server[/url]! Once again, thank you so much to everyone for playing our first public Demo, we can't wait for you to play the rest of the game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340812/c23749767e94f63b5f698aa3fad61e00be278193.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo patch update v0.1.1
notes.content: [h2]Hey Castaways, [/h2][p][/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone who has already played the Demo! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340812/93c6982b636643445c7c7e56982c203ce57abc51.gif"][/img][/p][p]Here's the first update to the public demo[/p][p][/p][h3]🐛Bugfixes:[/h3][list][*][p]The game will no longer save Unity logs to a folder on your desktop 😅[/p][/*][*][p]Input prompts should refer to the correct keys for AZERTY, Colemac and other Latin character layouts[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]📋Changes:[/h3][list][*][p]a toggle/ checkbox for post-processing in the pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]adjusted invisible walls and added a trigger that returns capy to the island[/p][/*][*][p]adjusted end-of-demo-popup text to clarify that you can continue playing[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you like to [b]report a bug[/b] in-game, when you're in the [b]pause menu[/b], you can select [b]Bug Reporter. [/b]Additionally, we are collecting player feedback, which you can share [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdxhy7VZTU8-NZcP2X06qfDeDPOf4OzTAgA5rze_YQKRuLoSQ/viewform" style="button" buttoncolor="#20ceb0"][b]here[/b][/url] or on our [url="https://discord.gg/zQgfEsG"]Discord server[/url]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340812/c23749767e94f63b5f698aa3fad61e00be278193.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🎉Capy Castaway Demo is here!🎉
notes.content:
[h1]Play the [b]Capy Castaway Demo[/b]🍊[/h1][p][/p][h3]Hey castaways![/h3][p]
We’re [i]so[/i] excited to share that the [b]Capy Castaway Demo [/b]will be live on Steam at 1pm EDT, as part of this year’s [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames"]Wholesome Games Celebration[/url]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340812/77033c3d117e56db72dfd4514dce4759d5f6a601.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340812/c23749767e94f63b5f698aa3fad61e00be278193.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3890490/Capy_Castaway_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]About the Demo:[/h2][p]
🏘️ Visit [b]Swallow Town[/b], a whimsical little hub filled with charming architecture, quirky characters, and a whole lot of charm.[/p][p]🍲 Compete in the [b]Great Swallow Town Cook-Off[/b], a legendary soup quest where you’ll forage for wild ingredients and maybe impress some very serious judges. [/p][p]🐾 Embrace the [b]Dynamic Duo[/b] gameplay! Capy can swim, sniff, and dig, while Corvi fetches items and helps you reach new places! [/p][p]🎩 Be [b]delightfully silly[/b]. Wear fruit, dash through mushroom rings, and carry a stick on your head just because it sparks joy. There’s no wrong way to play.[/p][p][/p][p]💫 Play the demo [b]today [/b]through [b]August 28[/b] as part of the [b]Wholesome Games Celebration[/b] on Steam![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340812/d08c8ea930e8a786c03b1271e80ba67c00fc435b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If you'd like to share feedback about your playthrough experience, you can fill out this [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdxhy7VZTU8-NZcP2X06qfDeDPOf4OzTAgA5rze_YQKRuLoSQ/viewform" style="button" buttoncolor="#675aff"]Feedback Form[/url][/p][p]If you're experiencing any bugs and would like more support beyond the bug reporter, you can join our [url="https://discord.gg/zQgfEsG " style="button" buttoncolor="#675aff"]Discord[/url] and use the #bugs-feedback channel for additional assistance.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for more amazing updates from us. We're heading to [url="https://indiearenabooth.de/gamescom2025/games/show/19093"]Gamescom 2025[/url], where we'll have a space in the Indie Arena Booth for folks to play Capy Castaway in person, meet the devs and, so much more! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340812/701ae711b27646b73e20922e022403b2540b43ab.png"][/img][/p]

notes.content:
